text: The purpose of this report is to request authority from the General Government Committee to amend blanket contract number 47023957 issued to Peter Young Ltd, o/a I.P.S. for grounds maintenance services, increasing the contract value by $1,429,206 net of all taxes and charges ($1,454,360 net of H.S.T. recoveries), and revising the current contract value from $4,180,500 net of all taxes and charges ($4,254,077 net of H.S.T. recoveries) to $5,609,706 net of all taxes and charges ($5,708,437 net of H.S.T. recoveries). This amendment is required to ensure service continuity of required summer and winter grounds maintenance services at City of Toronto locations. The General Government Committee: 1. In accordance with Section 71- 11.1C of the City of Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 71 (Financial Control By-law), authorized the amendment of blanket contract number 47023957 issued to Peter Young Ltd, o/a I.P.S. for grounds maintenance services, increasing the blanket contract value by $1,429,206 net of all taxes and charges ($1,454,360 net of H.S.T. recoveries), and revising the current blanket contract value from $4,180,500 net of all taxes and charges ($4,254,077 net of H.S.T. recoveries) to $5,609,706 net of all taxes and charges ($5,708,437 net of H.S.T. recoveries).
